review: headline: "EVCS" is an English abbreviation (electric vehicle charging stations) left unexplained in the Spanish text, so a Spanish reader can't tell what it means. It should read "estaciones de carga para vehículos eléctricos". Also, "sitios para subvenciones" is unclear; "grant sites" means sites for grant-funded stations (sitios de las subvenciones).
